title: Produce a one-target CRT guard stencil from paid unary geometry
body:
PR4201’s guard scanner left geometry/threshold construction and admission as unpriced host adapters. This adds an actual marker-driven producer for **one target from six protected unary fields** `G,H,K,Y,J,B_back`, then consumes its output with the unchanged scanner. Admission requires `G>=1,H>=G,K>=G+4,Y>=J+K`, nonnegative `J,B_back`. Binary/global/transported descriptor production and many-target integration remain open.

For every admitted unary input, the written proof gives the exact predecessor stencil, preserved inputs, eight erased private words/markers and returned heads. The producer uses only current-cell read/write/one-cell move and fixed finite control/alphabet. With `L=2H+Y+B_back`, `M=2^L`, setup is exactly `33H+25K+38Y-6G-J+12B_back+335 <= 63L+335`. Adding the retained scanner gives at most `8ML+15M+76L+353` actions on seventeen fixed roles and at most `M+7L+42` visited cells. Exact coefficients concern this cell/head model; fixed bit encoding introduces a constant factor. Stencil and mask are owned outputs; consuming/clearing old outputs before role reuse remains a caller duty.

Evidence:

- Primary:145 produced stencils /138,792 literal setup actions; four scanner compositions /5,760 addresses; seven clean grammar/arithmetic rejections, five executed semantic/ownership faults and two pre-execution source-authentication controls.
- Independently frozen pre-code oracle:83 geometries /433,280 addresses and360 larger boundary/parity/spectator cases. Root composition executes all433,280 addresses through the unchanged scanner and matches frozen masks plus both original CRT predicates; 67,748 setup actions and51,658,145 scanner actions, with three actual producer/consumer semantic faults.
- Separate macro-derived exact invoice and14 primitive-instrumented cases. One underbilled READ preserves final values/ownership but is detected:677 actual actions versus676 billed.
- Eight ordinary/strict-optimized registered commands pass locally and from exact committed Git-free bytes at `fb1f3c84535f3e5138bd07e7ed2f211f08fc296d`; all26 package/input files remain unchanged. Source history/bytes pass; all23 public package blobs match the frozen tree. Separate agent proof/contract/cost/package review passes, not human/formal-kernel acceptance.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/crt-unary-stencil-producer
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/crt-unary-stencil-producer --check-source-history
```

Handoff-first `uniform-transfer-audit`, refined scope; [canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4173#discussioncomment-19075225). Canonical main refreshed unchanged at `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244`, priority7. Submission overlap:322 open/draft bodies, current1166/4173; broader closed/code/Discussion coverage partial. The four minimal unchanged PR4201 exports are retained in public own ancestor `5a41fea466cbeb7839bde864e563e191de47a0f7`, preserving source availability and credit.

Remaining: actual unary input production/conversion; many-target admission/order; complete E/arithmetic, extraction/keys/sorting/repair/reinsertion; ordinary callees, precision, physical/native/outer composition and human/formal acceptance. This predicate projection is not a full production reservoir or CRT/multiplication theorem. Concrete open questions are in README/TASK.json.

Cinna Davis/PR4100 retains predicate/ordered-scan credit; Hiroki KUMAZAKI (`kumagi`)/PR4169/4174 retains repair/placement context; PR4201 at `4f49743a9df0cf7501cdc62bd5707a122fa071e9` retains scanner/atom/adapter/census credit; Douglas Colkitt/OpenAI and the retained NOTICE lineage remain credited. Prepared for ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate producer/proof, oracle and cost-review contexts. Apache-2.0. No new κ, merge or selected-frontier change. Maintainer edits disabled.
